principle: Evidence is traceable and family-deduplicated; correlated items do not become independent proof merely because multiple strategy-derived records exist.

families.MODEL_SELECTION: selection model and basket membership are correlated; count once
families.REGIME: market-regime context; not a second strategy vote

independenceRule: At most one independent evidence count per evidenceFamily within one candidate decision context; additional same-family items retain raw provenance and duplicateOf.
